scenario: On January 12, the heat in Omar's apartment stopped working. A repair technician arrived and fixed it 40 hours after the landlord first learned of the problem. Omar is now seeking a rent abatement.
policy: A landlord must make repairs that affect a unit's habitability within a reasonable time after receiving notice of the defect. A heating-system failure in winter must be repaired within 24 hours of notice; failure to do so entitles the tenant to a rent abatement.
question: Is Omar entitled to a rent abatement?
